svg.text: NATIVE TABLE LAYOUT; COLUMN WIDTHS ARE AUTO.
NO FIXED COLUMN SIZES ARE ASSIGNED BY TABLE.
SM / MD CONTROL MINIMUM ROW HEIGHTS.
WRAPPING OR TALL CONTENT CAN INCREASE THEM.
OUTLINE AND VERTICAL RULES ARE OPTIONAL.
HORIZONTAL RULES ARE ON BY DEFAULT.
HEADER ROW STICKS AT TOP ZERO; Z-INDEX 30.
PIN OFFSETS SUM MEASURED LEAF-COLUMN WIDTHS.
LOGICAL START / END REVERSE WITH DIRECTION.
CAPTION IS OUTSIDE THE SCROLL CONTAINER.
LOADING / EMPTY KEEP THE COLUMN STRUCTURE.
NO BORDER ON TR / THEAD / TBODY.
LAST BODY ROW DROPS ITS BOTTOM RULE.

g.text: SCALE 1:1 · SM · OPTIONAL OUTLINE / GRID · SCROLLED
COLUMN WIDTHS Cᵢ: AUTO / CALLER-DEFINED; ALL [TBD].
WIDTH AND HEIGHT HERE ARE PROPORTIONAL TO THE DEMO.
HATCH = EDGE FADES; HORIZONTAL MASK PRESERVES PINS.

svg.text: HEADER ABOVE BODY PINS; PINNED CELLS SCROLL WITH ROWS.
SCALE 2:1 · MINIMUM HEIGHTS, CONTENT CAN GROW
BODY LINE H5; PADDING S2 IS A MINIMUM.
H2 ≥ H5 + 2·S2 + B2; TABLE ROW HEIGHT CAN ADD SPACE.
PROPORTIONAL · INLINE START SHOWN; END IS MIRRORED
O₂ = C₁; P1 = C₁ + C₂; INNER JOIN STAYS OPAQUE.
F1 = MIN(D1, F0); NO HIDDEN CONTENT → NO FADE.
